Level of Experience All Job Function All Opportunity for promotion All Region All Institute All Language All Clear Select how often (in days) to receive an alert: Create Jobalert × Select how often (in days) to receive an alert: Apply now » City: Bremen Date: Sep 11, 2026 Master's thesis in the field of Medical Imaging and Digital Health The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft ( www.fraunhofer.com ) is one of the world's leading organizations for application-oriented research. 74 institutes develop pioneering technologies for our economy and society – more precisely: 30 000 people from technology, science, administration and IT. They know: Anyone who comes to Fraunhofer wants to and can make a difference. For themselves, for us and for the markets of today and tomorrow. The Fraunhofer Institute for Digital Medicine MEVIS is a world-leading and internationally connected research center for computer assistance in medicine. With about 140 employees, our mission is to conduct patient-centric research and development to improve clinical processes for the benefit of our clinical partners and, in the end, patients. Be part of change Modern AI systems in medicine increasingly rely on decentralized training paradigms such as federated or swarm learning. These promise privacy-preserving collaboration across hospitals but challenge current notions of transparency, auditability, and certification. While Model Cards and Data Cards are emerging as best practices, they are insufficient for complex, distributed AI services that evolve over time across multiple sites. Regulators, notified bodies and clinicians need new forms of monitoring and documentation that make such systems inspectable, trustworthy, and regulatory-ready. This thesis explores the concept of Federated AI Service Cards: How can we document, certify, and communicate decentralized medical AI systems in a way that satisfies regulatory requirements and builds trust among clinicians? What you contribute A Bachelor’s degree (B. Sc.) in Computer Science, Software engineering or a related field), and current enrollment in a Master's program Interest in AI, data science, HCI and Digital Health Practical experience with python programming, image processing, agent-based systems Ideally, good communication skills in both German and English You are enthusiastic about learning new practical skills, approach unfamiliar topics with curiosity and quickly and independently delve into them through your analytical approach. What we offer With our strong links to industry, you benefit from an environment where creative research freedom meets real-world application – with tangible societal impact. You actively contribute to shaping tomorrow’s medicine and gain insights into Europe’s leading organization for applied research. You will work as part of an international and interdisciplinary team, have access to state-of-the-art technologies and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom. You will gain valuable hands-on experience and prepare for future roles by learning relevant scientific methods and strengthening your skills in independently planning and conducting experiments. Throughout your time at Fraunhofer MEVIS, you will receive technically sound and collaborative supervision at eye level. The duration of the thesis depends on the requirements of your university. Please note: We cannot offer financial compensation for thesis work. However, you can expect an exciting research topic and intensive scientific supervision. We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, sexual orientation and identity. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability. Our tasks are diverse and adaptable – for applicants with disabilities, we work together to find solutions that best promote their abilities. With its focus on developing key technologies that are vital for the future and enabling the commercial utilization of this work by business and industry, Fraunhofer plays a central role in the innovation process. As a pioneer and catalyst for groundbreaking developments and scientific excellence, Fraunhofer helps shape society now and in the future. Ready for a change? Then apply now and make a difference! Please include a short letter of motivation with your application, explaining why you are interested in this topic for your thesis. Once we have received your online application, you will receive an automatic confirmation of receipt. We will then get back to you as soon as possible and let you know what happens next. Do you have questions about the position or the application process? jobs.description: Page contents Job Information Offer Description Where to apply Requirements Additional Information Work Location(s) Contact 27 Sep 2026 Job Information Organisation/Company Aalborg Universitet Department The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Computer Science Research Field Computer science Researcher Profile Recognised Researcher (R2) Application Deadline 13 Nov 2026 - 22:59 (UTC) Country Denmark Type of Contract Permanent Job Status Full-time Is the job funded through the EU Research Framework Programme? Not funded by a EU programme Is the Job related to staff position within a Research Infrastructure? No Offer Description Postdoc position in Human-Centred Artificial Intelligence The Department of Computer Science at Aalborg University invites applications for a postdoc position working with Professor Niels van Berkel. The earliest starting date for this position is 1st of January 2027. The project: Safeguarding Users’ Cognitive Autonomy in Human-AI Interaction Cognitive autonomy, our fundamental ability to think independently, is under threat from growing reliance on artificial intelligence (AI) technology. While designed to assist, AI recommendations may inadvertently impede cognitive reasoning and steer decision-making. This raises novel questions about designing systems that assist users while supporting independent thinking. To safeguard users’ cognitive autonomy, this project aims to identify when users’ cognitive autonomy is at risk and how timely digital interventions can support independent thinking. The position is a two-year role and funded by a DFF research project (‘Safeguarding Users’ Cognitive Autonomy in Human-AI Interaction’). Research objectives This project develops methods to detect changes in users' cognitive load and designs digital interventions that support cognitive autonomy , people's ability to think independently, in human-AI interaction. You will connect the project's technical work with its grounding in cognitive theory. The position suits candidates with a PhD in Human-Computer Interaction or a related field who enjoy making empirical, methodological, and technical contributions. You will have the opportunity to shape the project's direction based on your interests. Scientific dissemination is expected to focus on leading Human-Computer Interaction venues. For further information about the project, see: https://dff.dk/en/our-funded-projects/meet-the-researchers/research-leaders/eksterne-personer-en/research-leaders-2026/niels-van-berkel/. Your competencies You hold, or will soon obtain, a PhD degree in human-computer interaction, computer science, applied artificial intelligence, cognitive psychology, or a related field. You demonstrate strong collaboration skills and the ability to acquire new skills and technologies. Outstanding spoken and written communication skills are essential. Qualifications requirements Appointment as Postdoc presupposes scientific qualifications at PhD–level or similar scientific qualifications. If you have not yet completed or defended your PhD degree you can provide confirmation of upcoming graduation from your supervisor or PhD school. The research potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment. Appointment as a Postdoc cannot exceed a period of four years in total at Aalborg University. Who we are You will be part of the Human Augmentation and Collaboration research group ( https://www.cs.aau.dk/research/research-groups/human-augmentation-and-collaboration-hac ), an ambitious and supportive research environment in which we design and evaluate interactive systems that extend human cognitive, affective, and collaborative capabilities in digital environments. We frequently publish in the leading venues in Human-Computer Interaction and are supported through a strong network of collaborators. Interested applicants are encouraged to contact the project’s principal investigator, Prof. Niels van Berkel ( nielsvanberkel@cs.aau.dk ), prior to applying to discuss the scientific aspects of the position. How to apply Your application must include the following: Application letter: a maximum two-page letter stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position. Project description: a maximum three-page description outlining the applicant’s ideas on research directions within the context of the project, including a discussion of relevant related work. A complete list of publications must be attached with an indication of the works the applicant wishes to be considered. You may attach up to 5 publications. List of reference contact(s). Curriculum Vitae (CV). Diplomas Clearly AI-generated application material, as well as applications which fall outside of the project’s scope, will be dismissed. The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost. Further information Read more about our recruitment process here The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here . The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. Read more about The Technical Doctoral School of IT and Design. They know: Anyone who comes to Fraunhofer wants to and can make a difference. For themselves, for us and for the markets of today and tomorrow. As one of the world's largest solar energy research institutes, the Fraunhofer Institute for Solar Energy Systems ISE makes a significant contribution to a sustainable, economical, secure, and socially equitable energy supply worldwide. Our goal is to advance the energy transition by providing concrete, implementable technological solutions through excellent research results, successful industrial collaborations, and spin-offs. To this end, our ~1,300 employees conduct research in four key areas: energy supply, energy distribution, energy storage, and energy utilization. Fraunhofer ISE's state-of-the-art R&D infrastructure, with 22,300 m² of laboratory space, enables cutting-edge research at an international level. Be part of change Would you like to play an active role in shaping the energy transition and gain practical experience while you’re still in school? With us, you’ll help make this goal a reality. Together, we plan, build, and operate systems for the recovery of high-purity metals from aqueous solutions. To this end, the “Water Treatment and Material Separation” group has access to an extensive laboratory infrastructure equipped with state-of-the-art process technology. In addition, we have access to the institute’s full range of resources across all teams. Our group is currently pursuing a novel approach to selective ion extraction and is already conducting experimental process studies using a dedicated laboratory setup. To support our “Water Treatment and Material Separation” group, we are seeking a student assistant to begin immediately, with the opportunity to write a bachelor's or master's thesis, to perform the following tasks: You will work on scientific projects focused on the (re)extraction of lithium from natural aqueous sources. You will familiarize yourself with the fields of lithium extraction and electrochemistry. You will operate, analyze, and evaluate the automated process of electrochemical lithium extraction. The goal of your work is to derive and validate a physical model by varying process parameters. Your responsibilities will include conducting literature reviews and documenting your results. What you contribute You are studying process engineering, mechanical engineering, (electro)chemistry, or a comparable technical or scientific field. Knowledge of water treatment and electrochemistry is a plus, but not required. You can plan upcoming tasks independently and proactively and have good time management skills. You enjoy conducting experiments in a laboratory. Ideally, you have already worked with Excel, Word, and Origin. You can express yourself confidently in both German and English. What we offer Exclusive insights: By working together with the scientists in our department, you will gain insights into the day-to-day research and development work at a research institute. Laboratory infrastructure: At Fraunhofer ISE, we work with state-of-the-art equipment and devices so that research projects can be carried out using the latest technology. (Achtung: nur nutzen, wenn die Stelle Laborbezug hat!) Research mix: You will have the opportunity to combine experimental work with theory, thus applying and expanding the knowledge you gained during your studies. Supervision: You will be supervised by scientists during your work and receive feedback on your progress. Teamwork: You will gain experience in working in a team with our scientific and student staff and can contribute the experience you have already gained. Working hours and location: We offer you the opportunity to flexibly adjust your working hours to your needs and to occasionally work from home. Equal opportunities: We value equal opportunities and embrace diversity. After work: Celebrate yourself and your colleagues at after-work events or our annual employee parties. In addition to the thesis, a contract as a research assistant will be established. The remuneration for this is based on the degree of the academic qualification. They know: Anyone who comes to Fraunhofer wants to and can make a difference. For themselves, for us and for the markets of today and tomorrow. The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft plays a central role in the innovation process by focusing on key technologies of relevance to the future and on the utilization of the results in business and industry. As a trailblazer and driving force for innovative developments and scientific excellence, it helps to shape our society and our future. For over 35 years, the Fraunhofer Institute for Production Systems and Design Technology in Berlin has stood for excellence in production science. We are dedicated to combining science and practice in the field of industrial production and offer application-oriented system solutions for the entire range of industrial tasks - from product development to the production process, the maintenance of capital goods and the recycling of products through to the design and management of factory operations. In the Manufacturing Technologies department, which is part of the Production Systems division, we work on the development, provision and adaptation of production and manufacturing technologies for the manufacture of innovative products. We develop new machines and processing strategies on behalf of customers, optimize existing production systems and implement future-oriented tool concepts. Our core areas of expertise are machining technology, fine machining, cleaning and blasting processes, additive manufacturing as well as production and machine measurement technology. What you will do As part of the mandatory internship, you can be assigned to various areas of manufacturing technology. You will provide support in the areas of mechanical processing, in particular preparation and processing with CNC machine tools, and thus gain initial experience in industry-related research. You will work on current research and development projects and support the development of new systems and processes. To this end, you will examine the state of the art and the market situation, among other things. You will identify potential suppliers, dimension the required system components, and design them independently. Other tasks within the scope of the mandatory internship may include: Varied work in areas ranging from manufacturing to design and FE simulation to programming Working on CNC machine tools Planning, setting up, and evaluating test series Collaborating on and supporting current research and development projects Researching relevant topics and processing the results What you bring to the table studies in mechanical engineering, production engineering, information technology in mechanical engineering, or physical engineering Strong team player and able to work independently and responsibly Independence, determination, and a cautious and solution-oriented approach to work are your strengths Advanced knowledge of manufacturing technology, design engineering, and automation technology Experience with CAD/CAM and CNC machine tools is desirable Completed vocational training or experience in the field of metal technology, metal cutting, precision engineering, or toolmaking is desirable Confident use of MS Office programs Confident written and spoken German and English skills What you can expect a great team and an open, collegial atmosphere flexible working hours that can be combined with your studies an exciting and varied job in a leading research institute opportunities to work on current research projects insight into modern technologies and innovative manufacturing processes option to write your thesis (Bachelor/Master) in cooperation with our institute The weekly working time is 39 hours (full-time). Remuneration is based on the federal guidelines for internship remuneration. The duration of the thesis depends on the requirements of your university. The Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft attaches great importance to the professional equality of women and men. We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, We welcome applications from females in STEM professions. jobs.title: Facharzt Arbeitsmedizin / Werksarzt (Teilzeit, w/m/div.)
jobs.description:
{'title': 'Unternehmensbeschreibung', 'text': ' Bei Bosch Rexroth dreht sich alles um Bewegung und den Erfolg unserer Kunden. Mit unseren vernetzbaren Antriebs- und Steuerungstechnologien sowie digitalen Lösungen arbeiten Maschinen und Anlagen effizient, sicher und leistungsstark. Wir bieten unseren Kunden Komponenten, Systemlösungen und Services für mobile und industrielle Anwendungen ebenso wie für die Fabrikautomation. In allen Bereichen schätzen wir das Know-how und das Engagement unserer Mitarbeitenden und ermöglichen dynamische Karrieren in einem internationalen Umfeld. Rund 33.800 Menschen in über 80 Ländern - und ein Unternehmenszweck: „We move industries to make our planet a better place.” Willst auch du etwas bewegen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung bei der Bosch Rexroth AG. '} {'title': 'Stellenbeschreibung', 'text': ' Als Facharzt Arbeitsmedizin / Werksarzt (w/m/div.) in Teilzeit (14 h / Woche) bist du eine zentrale Säule für die Gesundheit und Sicherheit unserer rund 450 Mitarbeitenden am Standort Nürnberg: Im Rahmen der arbeitsmedizinischen Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sorgst du für sichere Arbeitsplätze und beurteilst bei Betriebsbegehungen potenzielle Gefahrenquellen nach der 
Verordnung zur arbeitsmedizinischen Vorsorge (ArbMedVV) sowie staatlichen und berufsgenossenschaftlichen Regelungen – von der Gabelstaplerbedienung bis zum ergonomischen Büroarbeitsplatz. Auch im Notfall behältst du stets einen kühlen Kopf und gewährleistest eine schnelle Erstversorgung, wobei du eng mit unserer Sanitätsschwester zusammenarbeitest. Du berätst unsere Mitarbeitenden kompetent bei dienstlichen Reisen (z.B. zu notwendigen/empfohlenen Impfungen) und führst Beratungen zur Rehabilitation am Arbeitsplatz durch. Darüber hinaus bist du am Betrieblichen Eingliederungsmanagement beteiligt und führst stufenweise Wiedereingliederungen durch. Gemeinsam mit dem Gesundheitsmanagement-Team förderst du ein gesundes Arbeitsumfeld, indem du Schulungen für Mitarbeitende sowie Führungskräfte entwickelst und neue Bewegungs- und Entspannungsangebote gestaltest. '} {'title': 'Qualifikationen', 'text': ' Ausbildung: erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Medizinstudium mit einer Facharztausbildung im Bereich Arbeitsmedizin oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation (auch in Weiterbildung möglich) Erfahrung und Know-How: ausgeprägte arbeits- und notfallmedizinische Kenntnisse; gute Kenntnisse im Bereich MS-Office Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: komplexe medizinische Sachverhalte vermittelst du allen Mitarbeitenden verständlich; du behältst insbesondere in Notfallsituationen den Überblick, arbeitest gerne und konstruktiv in einem Team, das sich regelmäßig austauscht und gerne diskutiert; innerhalb deiner Aufgaben genießt du hohen Gestaltungsspielraum und strebst schlanke Prozesse und höchste Qualität an Sprache: sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch; andere Sprachen von Vorteil '} {'title': 'Zusätzliche Informationen', 'text': ' Wir bieten flexible Arbeitsmodelle: von unterschiedlichen Teilzeitmöglichkeiten über mobiles Arbeiten bis hin zum Jobsharing. Sprich uns gerne dazu an. Vielfalt und Inklusion sind für uns keine Trends, sondern fest verankert in unserer Unternehmenskultur. Daher freuen wir uns über alle Bewerbungen: unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, Religion, ethnischer Herkunft oder sexueller Identität. Du hast Fragen zum Bewerbungsprozess? 
Eva Klein (Personalabteilung)

jobs.description: {'title': 'Unternehmensbeschreibung', 'text': ' Die Bosch Sensortec GmbH entwickelt und vermarktet Schlüsseltechnologien für die Unterhaltungselektronik – mikroelektromechanische Sensoren (MEMS) sowie Lösungen und Systeme für Anwendungen in Smartphones, Tablets, Videospielkonsolen, Wearables und dem Internet der Dinge. Die Sensoren ermöglichen es Geräten, ihre Umgebung zu erkennen und die erfassten Daten zu übertragen. MEMS sind damit ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Grundlage für eine vernetzte Welt. '} {'title': 'Qualifikationen', 'text': ' Ausbildung: Studium in einem relevanten Fachgebiet Erfahrung und Kenntnisse: Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Blender 3D Erfahrung in der Erstellung komplexer 3D-Animationen Vertrautheit mit Videoschnitt und Postproduktion Sehr gute Fähigkeiten in 3D-Modellierung, Texturierung und Animation Fähigkeit, den Videoschnitt von Rohmaterial bis zum finalen Schnitt umzusetzen Erfahrung mit Adobe Premiere Pro von Vorteil Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise: Sie sind eine motivierte Persönlichkeit, die Aufgaben eigenverantwortlich übernimmt und effektiv mit technischen sowie nicht-technischen Stakeholdern kommuniziert Arbeitsmodell: Teilweise mobiles Arbeiten ist möglich Begeisterung: Leidenschaft für 3D-Animation, Storytelling und Videoproduktion; Lernbereitschaft und Offenheit für neue kreative Herausforderungen Sprachen: Verhandlungssicheres Englisch '} {'title': 'Zusätzliche Informationen', 'text': ' Start: nach vorheriger Absprache Dauer: 6 Monate – 15 Std./Woche (Verlängerung möglich) Voraussetzung für diese Werkstudententätigkeit ist die Immatrikulation an einer Hochschule. B. Instagram oder YouTube) oder eine Portfolio-Website – und, sofern erforderlich, eine gültige Arbeits- und Aufenthaltserlaubnis. jobs.title: Entwicklungsingenieur für MEMS-Technologien (w/m/div.)
jobs.description:
{'title': 'Unternehmensbeschreibung', 'text': ' Bei Bosch gestalten wir Zukunft mit hochwertigen Technologien und Dienstleistungen, die Begeisterung wecken und das Leben der Menschen verbessern. Unser Versprechen an unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter steht dabei felsenfest: Wir wachsen gemeinsam, haben Freude an unserer Arbeit und inspirieren uns gegenseitig. Willkommen bei Bosch. Die Robert Bosch GmbH freut sich auf deine Bewerbung! '} {'title': 'Stellenbeschreibung', 'text': ' Werde Mitglied des MEMS-Teams! Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der MEMS-Sensoren und ermöglichen innovative Anwendungen in den Bereichen Automotive, Consumer und Industrie. Um unsere führende Marktposition in der Mikromechanik und Sensorik weiter zu stärken, suchen wir engagierte Entwicklungsingenieure, die sich für innovative Technologie und Prozessentwicklung begeistern. Das sind deine Aufgaben: Als Entwicklungsingenieur:in verantwortest und steuerst du innovative Technologieentwicklungen für komplexe Produkte (inklusive Terminplanung und Kundenschnittstelle). They know: Anyone who comes to Fraunhofer wants to and can make a difference. For themselves, for us and for the markets of today and tomorrow. Sensors play a pivotal role in modern analytical sciences, particularly in the development of high-performance platforms for the detection of biological and chemical analytes. Applications span health care, environmental monitoring, breath diagnostics (breathonics), and industrial safety. Whether detecting biomarkers in body fluids or volatile organic compounds (VOCs) in exhaled breath, target molecules are typically found at trace concentrations, often in complex sample matrices. This necessitates the design of sensing systems that are highly sensitive, selective, and robust under diverse operating conditions. Nanomaterial-based sensor platforms, such as carbon nanotube (CNT)-based field-effect transistors (FETs), emerged as promising candidates, enabling the development of compact, label-free, and real-time sensors suitable for point-of-care diagnostics and opening doors for wearable health technologies. This project work or master's thesis focuses on the analytical and structural characterization of such nanoengineered sensors tailored for biological sensing or gas detection applications. The work includes the selective functionalization of sensor surfaces, optimization of sensor interface chemistry, and evaluation of device performance in liquid or gaseous environments. The device functionalization and structural modifications are studied via microscopy analysis, Raman spectroscopy, atomic force microscopy, and the sensor response is monitored via electrical measurements. The goal is to correlate surface structure and composition with sensing behavior, contributing to a multimodal understanding of sensor performance. In particular, the sensor structures – thanks to their transistor configuration and modular functionalization options – enable AI-based evaluation methods, such as principal component analysis. We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic student to join our team for a project work or master's thesis, where you will have the opportunity to make significant contributions to cutting-edge sensor technologies in the fields of biological sensing and gas detection. In cooperation with the Chair of Laser Technology (LLT), the Fraunhofer Institute for Laser Technology (ILT)—Europe’s leading center for contract research and development in the field of laser technology—is offering the opportunity to write a thesis on the topic: »Real-Time Spectroscopic Monitoring of Microvias Powering the AI Revolution«. The explosive growth of artificial intelligence is driving an unprecedented demand for high-density interconnect printed circuit boards. Next-generation AI chips require ever finer microvias to connect increasingly thin copper layers through dielectric substrates. Today, CO₂ lasers are the industrial standard for via drilling, but their minimum feature size is physically limited. Ultrashort pulsed lasers offer a path to significantly smaller vias. However, a critical challenge arises: unlike CO₂ radiation, the 515 nm USP beam couples efficiently into copper, meaning the very copper layer that must be preserved is ablated alongside the dielectric. As copper layers shrink to thicknesses below 5 µm, even a single excess pulse can cause irreversible damage. This thesis addresses this challenge by developing a real-time, in-line endpoint detection system. The plasma generated by each individual laser pulse is spectrally analysed to detect the characteristic copper emission—the instant copper is exposed, the process stops. This enabels damage-free microvia drilling at industrial throughputs. jobs.description: Infineon Technologies in Romania has been leading the way in semiconductor development, taking chips from conception to market readiness since its establishment in 2005. As we aim to expand and enhance our expertise, an exciting opportunity has emerged for the establishment of a new team dedicated to memory applications. As a team player, you possess a unique ability to think and act cooperatively, establishing successful collaborations with other teams within Infineon. Your cooperative mindset enables you to navigate complex projects with ease, fostering a culture of mutual support and driving collective success. They know: Anyone who comes to Fraunhofer wants to and can make a difference. For themselves, for us and for the markets of today and tomorrow. WE RESEARCH FOR A HEALTHY WORLD – AND OFFER DIVERSE OPPORTUNITIES. CHANGE STARTS WITH US. At the Fraunhofer Institute for Interfacial Engineering and Biotechnology IGB, we combine biology and engineering for health, nutrition, sustainable chemistry, the environment, and climate protection. We develop processes, technologies, and products for patient-centered healthcare, a sustainable bioeconomy, and a climate-neutral and resource-efficient circular economy, bringing new solutions successfully to industrial implementation. We conduct research at the Stuttgart, Biberach, Leuna, and Straubing sites and in close collaboration with numerous universities and research institutions at home and abroad. Be part of change Your role involves the preparation, characterization, and screening of heterogeneous catalysts. Using reaction engineering principles, you evaluate the performance of heterogeneous catalysts in batch and continuous-flow reactors. Analytical techniques such as GC, HPLC, and NMR enable you to evaluate experimental results, and you will present scientific findings orally and in writing. What you contribute You are studying chemical engineering, chemistry, process engineering, materials science, or a related degree program. Experience in laboratory work, materials synthesis, and reactor operation is advantageous. Proficiency with material characterization techniques and tools such as MATLAB, OriginPro, and ChemCAD is advantageous but not mandatory. You have strong written and spoken English; knowledge of German is advantageous but not required. Last but not least, you excel with a team-oriented and responsible work style, as well as the ability to work independently and scientifically. What we offer Cutting-edge research across a wide variety of pioneering flagship projects that advance society, the economy — and yourself. The chance to contribute your own ideas as part of a strong team and find solutions for pressing future questions. A tolerant environment with an open culture of learning from mistakes, with support available at any time. State-of-the-art equipment. An on-site cafeteria with daily meal options. For the preparation of the Master’s thesis, no remuneration is paid. We offer comprehensive supervision and support. Additionally, there is the possibility of concluding a contract as a Research Assistant. Remuneration is based on the collective agreement for student assistants. This position is available on a part-time basis. We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, sexual orientation and identity. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability. Our tasks are diverse and adaptable – for applicants with disabilities, we work together to find solutions that best promote their abilities. The same applies if they do not meet all the profile requirements due to a disability. With its focus on developing key technologies that are vital for the future and enabling the commercial utilization of this work by business and industry, Fraunhofer plays a central role in the innovation process. As a pioneer and catalyst for groundbreaking developments and scientific excellence, Fraunhofer helps shape society now and in the future. Ready for a change? Then apply now and make a difference! Once we have received your online application, you will receive an automatic confirmation of receipt. We will then get back to you as soon as possible and let you know what happens next. Do you have questions about the position, the application process, or accessibility? Do you need assistance? B. Quantisierung, Pruning, TinyML) ⦁ Entwicklung adaptiver Lernmechanismen für sich verändernde Umgebungsbedingungen ⦁ Entwicklung von Tool-Chains zur Portierung von KI-Modellen auf verschiedene, eingebettete Systeme Bitte geben Sie bei Ihrer Bewerbung an, für welches Thema Sie sich interessieren. B. Keras oder PyTorch) und das Administrieren von unixoiden Betriebssystemen sind von Vorteil Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Teamfähigkeit Was Sie erwarten können ⦁ Vielfältige Einblicke in die Arbeit von wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeitenden an einem Forschungsinstitut ⦁ Möglichkeit, das Wissen aus dem Studium direkt anzuwenden ⦁ Vergütung der Abschlussarbeit, flexible Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeitmodell) und ein fester Urlaubsanspruch ⦁ Möglichkeit, erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit SAP zu sammeln ⦁ Zentrale Lage direkt neben dem Campus Duisburg (Linie 933: Haltestelle Universität) Die Vergütung richtet sich nach der Gesamtbetriebsvereinbarung zur Beschäftigung der Hilfskräfte Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. '} {'title': 'Job Description', 'text': " Residential heat pumps can provide electrical flexibility by utilizing the thermal storage available in buildings, domestic hot water (DHW) tanks, and buffer storage systems. 
This Master's thesis focuses on the automated estimation and forecasting of the flexibility potential of residential heat pump systems. Building on existing concepts and methods, you will investigate how thermal characteristics and storage capacities can be identified from monitoring data and used to quantify the flexibility that a heat pump system can provide. You will review existing approaches, analyze field monitoring data, and define suitable data processing workflows. Based on this data, you will identify key thermal parameters of buildings and storage systems and use them to estimate available flexibility over time. Furthermore, you will integrate the developed models into a flexibility forecasting workflow and evaluate their performance using real-world data. The analysis will cover both individual homes and aggregated fleets of heat pumps, including the impact of aggregation on flexibility estimation and forecasting accuracy. As part of the thesis, you will extend and validate an automated end-to-end workflow covering: Data preprocessing and quality assessment, Thermal system characterization, Estimation of thermal storage capacity, Flexibility estimation and forecasting, Analysis of individual systems and aggregated fleets. Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung In der Abteilung »Medizintechnik und Pharmazeutische Systeme« bieten wir interessierten und motivierten Studierenden die Möglichkeit, eine Studien- oder Masterarbeit im Themenbereich »Methodenentwicklung zur Erzeugung von künstlichem Fouling auf unterschiedlichen Materialien« zu erfassen. In verfahrenstechnischen Anlagen z. B. der Lebensmittel- und Getränkeindustrie kommt es immer wieder zu unerwünschten Ablagerungen (Fouling), die regelmäßig durch energie- und chemieintensive Reinigungsprozesse entfernt werden müssen. Am Fraunhofer IST werden Technologien entwickelt, die eine skalierbare, chemiefreie Erzeugung reaktiver Reinigungsflüssigkeiten ermöglichen. Um diese Technologien zu erproben, sind zuverlässige Messmethoden essenziell. In der folgenden Arbeit soll eine Methode erarbeitet werden, die künstliches Fouling anhand von Modellsubstraten auf verschiedenen Oberflächen ermöglicht. Es soll dabei sowohl Kristallisationsfouling (durch Salze) und Biofouling (durch Proteine und Alginat) dargestellt werden können. Aufbau eines Versuchsstands zur definierten Beprobung von unterschiedlichen Werkstoffen für Foulinguntersuchungen Methodenentwicklung zur Erzeugung eines definierten Fouling-Films unter Variation der Prozessparameter Untersuchung der Reproduzierbarkeit Bewertung der Oberflächen nach Fouling Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein Immatrikulation in der Fachrichtung Bio-, Chemie- oder Pharmaingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Materialwissenschaften, Chemie oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung Spaß am experimentellen und praktischen Arbeiten Erfahrungen im Labor oder in der Analytik können nützlich sein Gute Kenntnisse im MS-Office-Paket sowie ggf. Kenntnisse in Origin Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Sie zeichnen sich während der Erstellung der studentischen Arbeit durch Flexibilität, Zuverlässigkeit, Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Motivation aus und arbeitest selbstständig, diszipliniert sowie gewissenhaft an den Fragestellungen. Was wir für Sie bereithalten Mitarbeit an innovativen Forschungsprojekten mit hohem Praxisbezug Interessante Einblicke in aktuelle Forschungsthemen Möglichkeit zur Durchführung von wissenschaftlichen Arbeiten (Bachelor-, Studien-, Masterarbeit) Der Arbeitsort ist in Braunschweig. Barrierefreiheit und Chancengleichheit Am Fraunhofer IST verstehen wir Vielfalt und Inklusion als zentralen Bestandteil unserer Institutskultur. Daher setzen wir uns aktiv dafür ein, Barrieren abzubauen und ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Menschen wertgeschätzt und einbezogen werden. Die Gleichbehandlung aller Mitarbeitenden ist für uns nicht nur selbstverständlich – sie bildet die Grundlage für eine gute Zusammenarbeit und damit letztendlich für den Erfolg unseres Instituts. Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern. Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft

"} {'title': 'Job Description', 'text': " Your contribution to something big: Are you passionate about bringing innovative technology to life, ensuring every product meets the highest standards from concept to mass production? At Bosch eBike Systems , we are revolutionizing urban mobility with connected devices and human-machine interfaces. As our Industrialization Project Manager , you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless, high-quality, and cost-effective production of our next-generation eBike solutions. Pioneer Production Excellence: Serve as the key Industrialization and Manufacturing expert, representing Bosch eBike Systems both with our global suppliers and internally, particularly for our cutting-edge Connected Devices and Human Machine Interfaces. 
 Drive Strategic Outcomes: Lead the charge for industrialization and production, ensuring all projects consistently achieve our ambitious quality, cost, and delivery targets. 
 Forge Technical Partnerships: Act as the primary technical interface with our Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) partners, managing all aspects from sample builds to full-scale production. You will meticulously manage supplier schedules and deliverables, guaranteeing timely and efficient execution. 
 Optimize Production Capacity: Ensure our production lines not only meet but exceed required capacity and uphold Bosch's stringent quality standards. 
 Orchestrate Project Success: Coordinate complex industrialization projects, strategically prioritizing tasks and managing interdependencies to maintain an optimized schedule. 
 Innovate & Anticipate: Continuously analyze and enhance production processes, proactively monitoring their performance to implement improvements and foster innovation. 
 Collaborate Globally: Cultivate strong, active collaborations with diverse internal teams, external organizations, and international suppliers, fostering a cohesive and efficient global network. 
 Empower Team Spirit: Partner effectively with internal and external stakeholders, championing collaborative solutions and contributing to a positive, high-performing team environment. 
 Strategic Supplier Vetting: Conduct comprehensive assessments of supplier capabilities (technical, quality, capacity) to ensure they meet Bosch's strategic needs and long-term vision. jobs.title: Service Administrator
jobs.description: {'title': 'Bedrijfsomschrijving', 'text': ' Bosch Home Comfort is gespecialiseerd in duurzame en energie-efficiënte oplossingen voor verwarming, koeling en warm water. Met sterke merken zoals Bosch en Buderus bieden we innovatieve oplossingen voor zowel residentiële als professionele toepassingen. Voor onze Customer Care-afdeling binnen After Sales in Mechelen zijn we op zoek naar een Service Administrator . '} {'title': 'Vacatureomschrijving', 'text': ' Jouw bijdrage aan iets groots Als Service Administrator ben je een belangrijke schakel tussen onze klanten, techniekers, serviceorganisatie en interne afdelingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat de administratieve en commerciële opvolging van onze serviceactiviteiten vlot en correct verloopt. Je functie is daarbij veel meer dan administratie alleen. Je bent een allrounder die graag verschillende verantwoordelijkheden opneemt en vlot schakelt tussen uiteenlopende taken. Je verwerkt en volgt service-interventies administratief op. Je bereidt facturatie en creditnota’s voor en zorgt voor een correcte opvolging. Je ondersteunt bij het opmaken en opvolgen van service-offertes. Je denkt mee over opportuniteiten binnen contractmanagement. Je beantwoordt vragen van klanten en interne collega’s en zoekt actief naar oplossingen. Je bewaakt prioriteiten en zorgt ervoor dat verschillende dossiers correct en tijdig worden opgevolgd. Je kijkt kritisch naar onze manier van werken, signaleert verbeterpunten en neemt initiatief om processen slimmer en efficiënter te organiseren. '} {'title': 'Functie-eisen', 'text': ' Wat jou onderscheidt Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring binnen customer service, serviceadministratie of een administratief-commerciële omgeving. Je bent communicatief sterk en communiceert helder, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en Frans en kunt je goed uitdrukken in het Engels. Je bent oplossingsgericht, neemt initiatief en wacht niet af wanneer zich een probleem voordoet. Je kunt goed prioriteiten stellen en behoudt het overzicht wanneer verschillende vragen tegelijk op je afkomen. Je houdt van afwisseling en voelt je goed in een rol waarin je verschillende verantwoordelijkheden combineert. Je staat open voor verandering en denkt graag mee over hoe we onze werking verder kunnen verbeteren. Je werkt vlot met MS Office en maakt nieuwe systemen en tools snel eigen. jobs.title: CNC-operatörer
jobs.description:
{'title': 'Företagsbeskrivning', 'text': ' Hägglunds är en del av Bosch Rexroth och har en historia som sträcker sig 60 år bakåt i tiden. I dag är vårt företag en ledande tillverkare av hydrauliska drivsystem och lösningar. Kunderna återfinns inom branscher som bland annat återvinning, socker- och materialhanteringen. Hägglunds har sitt huvudkontor och huvudproduktion i Mellansel, strax utanför Örnsköldsvik. Här ryms alla funktioner under ett tak: Från utveckling och produktion till försäljning och service. Hägglunds har cirka 600 medarbetare runtom i världen, varav cirka 400 jobbar i Mellansel. Fem CNC-operatörer har nyligen valt att börja hos oss på Hägglunds. Nu söker vi fler kollegor som vill bli en del av vår produktion och arbeta med avancerad tillverkning i en modern industrimiljö. Här kombineras hög teknisk kompetens med stark laganda, säkerhetstänk och goda möjligheter att utvecklas tillsammans med verksamheten. Är du vår nya kollega? '} {'title': 'Jobbeskrivning', 'text': ' Som CNC-operatör ansvarar du för att tillverka artiklar enligt kundkrav, ritningar och produktionsunderlag. Du har en viktig roll i att säkerställa kvalitet, leveransprecision och effektiva arbetssätt. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att: Tillverka artiklar enligt produktionsplan (svarvning eller fräsning) Säkerställa kvalitet genom mätning och kontroll enligt kontrollplan Plocka ut ritningar och andra instruktioner från systemet vid behov Rapportera utfört arbete och avvikelser i våra system Utföra operatörsunderhåll och dagliga kontroller enligt instruktion Hantera material, verktyg och övriga förnödenheter som krävs i produktionen Bidra till förbättringsarbete inom säkerhet, kvalitet och produktivitet Säkerheten kommer alltid först och vi förväntar oss att alla medarbetare aktivt bidrar till en säker och välorganiserad arbetsmiljö. Andra arbetsuppgifter på avdelningen kan förekomma. '} {'title': 'Kvalifikationer', 'text': ' Vi söker dig som är noggrann, ansvarstagande och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Du har ett kvalitetsmedvetet arbetssätt och gillar att lösa problem när de uppstår. Vi ser gärna att du har: Gymnasieutbildning inom industri eller teknik, alternativt eftergymnasial yrkesutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet Meriterande med kunskap i ritningsläsning Meriterande med erfarenhet av mätteknik och kvalitetskontroller Förståelse för tillverkningsprocesser och produktion Det är viktigt att du har ett intresse för teknik och en vilja att lära dig nya arbetsuppgifter. Vi arbetar för att skapa bred kompetens i verksamheten och ser positivt på att utvecklas inom flera områden. '} {'title': 'Ytterligare information', 'text': ' Vill du veta mer om tjänsten? 
Kontakta då rekryterande chefer: Marcus Sellgren, gruppchef Bearbetning kamringar och kolvar på 0660-87019 eller marcus.sellgren@boschrexroth.se 
Christoffer Norberg, gruppchef Bearbetning stora block på 0660-87026 eller christoffer.norberg@boschrexroth.se Mer information om Hägglunds produkter och drivsystem kan du hitta på www.hagglunds.com Vill du ansöka tjänsten? 
Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-10-31 . Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden så tillsättning kan komma att ske innan ansökningstiden gått ut. Ansök därmed gärna så snart som möjligt! Vill du veta med om att jobba och leva i Örnsköldsvik Kommun? 
Om du inte kommer från området, så kan du på ett lättsamt sätt få en bild av ditt framtida liv i Örnsköldsvik här ! Varför jobba vid Bosch Rexroth i Mellansel? Välkommen till ett unikt globalt företag med en lång lokal historia och förmåner i olika former. I Mellansel möts det bästa av två världar: Internationell puls i en familjär lokal miljö. Som också är en miljö där alla funktioner ryms under ett tak och där du har kollegor som är alltifrån ingenjörer och operatörer till inköpare och säljare. Här har du möjlighet att både utveckla dig själv och vår verksamhet. För oss är mångfald självklart inte bara globalt inom Bosch Rexroth utan också lokalt i Mellansel. Här samarbetar kollegor av olika nationalitet, kön, ålder och bakgrund och med olika erfarenheter. På så sätt kan vi tillsammans utvecklas och hela tiden få nya perspektiv. Vi vet att vi inte är ensamma om att ha fantastiska kollegor. Men vi vet också att våra medarbetare berättar om de fina arbetskamraterna och att det finns en anda av att hjälpa och ta hand om varandra. Hos oss ska det vara roligt att gå till jobbet och vi ska gå dit med god hälsa. Och när vi går hem för dagen ska hälsan vara minst lika god och vi ska känna att det är lika roligt att komma tillbaka nästa dag. Hur är det att jobba hos oss? Allt vi gör handlar om att röra oss framåt och genom att göra det vinner både våra kunder och vi. Vår kultur har byggts upp sedan Hägglunds hjärta började slå i Mellansel och har sedan dess utvecklats i andan av en global vinnarkultur. Vi beskriver oss själva med att vi är kundfokuserade, innovativa, modiga, agila och excell

jobs.title: Szériatámogató minőségbiztosítási mérnök /McP kéziszerszámgyár/
jobs.description: {'title': 'A cég leírása', 'text': ' Szeretnél ötleteiddel hasznos technológiák fejlesztéséhez hozzájárulni? Legyen szó a mobilitási megoldásokról, fogyasztói cikkekről, ipari technológiáról, energetikáról vagy építéstechnológiáról: Velünk lehetőséged nyílik arra, hogy javíts az emberek életminőségén világszerte. Köszöntünk a Bosch világában! A Robert Bosch Power Tool Elektromos Szerszámgyártó Kft . 2001 novemberében alakult Miskolcon, és mára nem csupán a cégcsoporton belül, hanem a régióban is meghatározó szereplővé vált, világszerte a Bosch legnagyobb kéziszerszámgyára lett. Főbb termékeink: ✅zöld kéziszerszámok és kertigépek mindennapos használatra ☑️kék kéziszerszámok professzionális felhasználásra 🚴\u200d♂️eBike és kéziszerszám akkumulátorok Célunk , hogy folyamatosan továbbfejlesszük termékeinket és ebben nagymértékben számítunk munkatársaink kiemelkedő teljesítményére. Csatlakozz Te is a több mint 20 éves múlttal rendelkező kéziszerszámgyárunkhoz, ahol a több különböző iparágunk nyújtotta stabilitást jelenleg megközelítőleg 4000 munkavállalónk élvezi. '} {'title': 'Az állás leírása', 'text': ' Rendszerszintű problémamegoldás: A felelősségi körbe tartozó termékek szériagyártása során felmerülő minőségi problémák önálló kezelése; multidiszciplináris problémamegoldó (pl. 8D, PSS) teamek vezetése és moderálása. Strukturált hibaok-elemzés: Módszertani hibaok-elemzések (Ishikawa, 5Why, Pareto) lefolytatása a kijelölt gyártósorokon a selejtarány csökkentése érdekében. Vevői reklamációk kezelése: Aktív részvétel a vevői reklamációk kivizsgálásában, kockázatelemzések (Risk Assessment) kidolgozásában és a helyesbítő intézkedések hatékony bevezetésében. Minőségügyi dokumentáció menedzsment: Gyártási és ellenőrzési dokumentációk (Control Plan / Ellenőrzési Terv, folyamatleírások, mérőlapok) folyamatos naprakészen tartása és felülvizsgálata. Kockázatkezelés (FMEA): Aktív részvétel a folyamat-FMEA (p-FMEA) felülvizsgálatában és frissítésében. Statisztikai folyamatkontroll: Gép- és folyamatképesség-vizsgálatok (SPC — Cmk, Cpk) elvégzése, kiértékelése és a szükséges megelőző intézkedések meghatározása. KPI monitorozás: Gyártósori minőségi mutatók rendszeres felülvizsgálata, trendelemzések készítése, eszkalációs folyamatok indítása és problémamegoldó teamek kezdeményezése. Mérőeszköz-menedzsment: A gyártási folyamatokhoz szükséges mérő- és ellenőrzőeszközök, készülékek definiálása és specifikálása (MSA szempontok alapján). Társosztályi együttműködés: Próbagyártások és beépítési próbák minőségügyi támogatása; szoros együttműködés a termeléssel, technológiával, logisztikával és a fejlesztéssel. '} {'title': 'Elvárások', 'text': ' Végzettség: Felsőfokú műszaki/mérnöki végzettség (pl. gépészmérnök, villamosmérnök, mechatronikai mérnök vagy minőségbiztosítási szakmérnök). Szakmai tapasztalat: 3–5 év releváns szakmai tapasztalat szériatámogató vagy gyártósori minőségbiztosítási területen (multinacionális gyártási környezet előnyt jelent). Módszertani ismeretek: Autóipari minőségügyi eszközök (Core Tools: SPC, MSA, FMEA, 8D) magabiztos, gyakorlati szintű ismerete és alkalmazása. Nyelvtudás: Kiváló kommunikációs és érdekérvényesítő képesség; angol nyelvtudás szóban és írásban Személyes kompetenciák: Erős analitikus és strukturált problémamegoldó gondolkodásmód; önálló, proaktív személyiség, kiemelkedő stressztűrő és priorizálási képesség dinamikus gyártási környezetben. '} {'title': 'További információk', 'text': ' Ismerd meg mit jelent a Work #LikeABosch. GROW - Nálunk kibontakozhatsz. jobs.title: Press Office Internship
jobs.description: {'title': 'Company Description', 'text': ' Let’s turn visions into reality. At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our areas of activity are every bit as diverse as our outstanding Bosch-teams around the world. Their creativity is the key to innovation through connected living, mobility or industry. Our responsibility goes far beyond ‘business’. We’re independent of stock markets and bound to the purpose of the Robert Bosch Foundation; our success directly benefits society, the environment, and future generations. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference. Let’s be remarkable! Welcome to a place where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch. '} {'title': 'Job Description', 'text': ' As a Press Office Intern , you will join the Corporate Communication team and support daily press office and external communication activities. You will have the opportunity to develop your communication and writing skills in an international and dynamic environment, contributing to the creation of engaging and high-quality content for different audiences and communication channels. In particular, you will: Support the writing and editing of press releases, articles, news, corporate texts and communication materials , adapting tone of voice and language to different target audiences and channels. Contribute to the preparation of media content, press kits, briefings and presentations . Support the management of relationships with journalists, media and external stakeholders. Monitor daily media coverage and support press reviews and media monitoring activities . Contribute to the identification and development of relevant corporate stories and communication opportunities. Support the organization of press conferences, interviews, media events and corporate initiatives . Collaborate with internal departments and communication colleagues to collect information and transform technical or business topics into clear, accurate and engaging written content . Support the maintenance and updating of press office databases, editorial materials and communication channels. '} {'title': 'Qualifications', 'text': ' Education: \nBachelor’s or Master’s degree, ongoing or recently completed, in Communication, Journalism, Humanities, Languages, Marketing or a related field. Experience and Know-how: Excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills , with particular attention to grammar, style and clarity. Ability to structure information and turn complex topics into simple, effective and engaging texts . Excellent command of Italian and good knowledge of English, both written and spoken. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Word. Interest in journalism, media relations, corporate communication and current affairs. Previous experience in writing articles, university publications, blogs, social media content or editorial projects will be considered a plus. '} {'title': 'Additional Information', 'text': ' What We Offer: Duration: 6 Months Full Time Internship (Curricular or Extracurricular); Internships foresee reimbursement at Bosch Italia. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin or ancestry, age, disability or any other protected class. www.bosch.it https://www.bosch.it/lavora-con-noi/ '}
